attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored by accredited schools of veterinary medicine or veterinary technology, Board-approved courses and other approved categories listed by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the calendar year of graduation from an AVMA-approved veterinary technology program.
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; keep documentation 4 years after the calendar year of completion and produce it if the Board asks. Missed hours must be made up with a letter and certificates.
rules.notes: Licensed veterinary medical technicians: 12 h per calendar year, due Dec 31; max 4 h multi-media (internet, webinars, teleconference).
